input: Fact-check my Wikipedia article draft before publishing

gold.taskTitle: Fact-check Wikipedia article draft before publishing
gold.taskDescription: Review and verify the factual accuracy of the user's Wikipedia article draft prior to submitting it for publication.

questions.title: What is the topic or subject of the article?
questions.description: Identify the specific person, place, event, or concept the article covers.

questions.title: How long is the draft in words or sections?
questions.description: Understand the scope and volume of content that needs fact-checking.

questions.title: Which claims are you most uncertain about?
questions.description: Pinpoint the specific facts, dates, or statements the user already suspects may be inaccurate.

questions.title: Do you have existing sources cited in the draft?
questions.description: Determine whether references or footnotes are already attached to claims in the article.

questions.title: What type of facts dominate the article?
questions.description: Clarify whether the content is primarily historical dates, scientific data, biographical details, statistics, or another category.

questions.title: Is this a new article or an edit to an existing one?
questions.description: Establish whether the draft is being created from scratch or is a revision of a live Wikipedia page.

questions.title: What is your deadline for publishing the article?
questions.description: Understand the time constraint so the fact-checking process can be prioritised accordingly.
